__comment_input: Output of PreprocessPLsGVCF. Despite the workflow name the input is the pasted multi-sample PL VCF, which is what the gVCF path produces.
__comment_chunked_panel: Output of GLIMPSE2SplitLeaveoutPanel -- the LEAVEOUT .bin files. NOT rw-long-reads-transfer-2026-07-24/chunked_panel, which was split from the full panel and would make this circular. n_variants_by_region is already in this JSON; no add-panel-variant-counts.py backfill needed.
__comment_pop_resources: Panel resources for the popping step. Use the LEAVEOUT panel's sites-only and id-split VCFs to match the panel imputed against.
__comment_parity: Leave these at production values. They change the result, and the thread/Kpbwt pair also feeds the phase memory formula (4 + ceil(11.0*threads*Kpbwt*L/1e9)), so an override changes both what runs and what it costs.
